company_name: National Center for Instrumentation Research, National Institutes Applied Research
semiconductor_relevance: Low — NCIR primarily focuses on research and development in instrumentation and optics rather than direct semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: The National Center for Instrumentation Research (NCIR) specializes in advancing instrumentation platforms that support national science and technology development. While it plays a role in fostering innovation and research, its contributions are more aligned with academic and industrial collaboration rather than direct semiconductor production.
capabilities: Prototyping and customization of opto-electro-mechanical systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: NCIR is based in Taiwan and has been a pioneer in optics and vacuum technology since its establishment.
